description: This file contains test cases for helper functions related to the 'anthropic vertex region' within the 'extensions/anthropic-vertex' module. It uses the 'vitest' testing framework to verify the correct behavior of functions resolving regions based on environment variables and base URLs.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicVertexRegion
methods.description: Resolves the region string based on environment variables, defaults to 'global' if malformed.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicVertexRegionFromBaseUrl
methods.description: Parses the base URL to determine the Vertex region, returns 'global' for known global endpoints, undefined otherwise.
